definition: Common absolute N_ch boundaries, one set shared by all three tunes and both sectors. Labels are percentiles of the MONASH minimum-bias distribution; the per-tune MB-percentile translation is PUBLISHED as a residual rather than hidden.
boundary_convention: half-integer, so no integer N_ch is ambiguous about which class it falls in; class k spans [boundary_k, boundary_k+1) and the last class is open-ended
percentile_labels_are_recomputed: The MONASH-MB percentile of each boundary is NOT stored here. It is recomputed from the committed MB samples in anchors/b4_multiplicity_mb as the fraction strictly below the boundary, so the label cannot drift away from the sample it claims to describe. Storing it would create a second definition.
single_definition_note: THIS FILE IS THE ONE DEFINITION OF THE AXIS. Both consumers read it: plotting/paper/make_paper_figures.py (figure 3) and plotting/improvedPlotting_THnSparse.C (common_absolute multiplicity mode). Neither may carry a literal copy — two definitions drift, and the axis is the thing every per-multiplicity number is conditioned on.
